method: Exact prior independent model templates and pre-reload projection templates; 75 derives only score/text arithmetic. No current-run data or application update execution.

provenance.projectionLimit: Baseline-only properties came from direct scene getters before the prior reload; post geometry was precomputed. This is a relative projection oracle, not an independent reconstruction of every scene constant.

projectionRelations: Entity names are exactly baseEntityNames + lifeNames + actual model brick keys, sorted with no duplicates.
Every actual brick key has an existing projection with exactly its model position, size and color.
Paddle and ball projection position and size match the actual model, with the bound default colors.
Every pre-reset brick entity absent from the new model is absent from the projection; a key legitimately reused by the new model is judged against that new model.
Random ball direction, generated brick keys and colors are retained, not predicted across processes; the next halted callback must preserve them exactly.
sourceBasis: Pinned Gameplay.initial and Gameplay.empty, Paddle.initial, Ball.initial and Content
